items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: Yes. Please request one on the booking page and I will confirm a time with you on WhatsApp.

items.question: What are the clinic hours?
items.answer: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 am to 7:00 pm.

items.question: Can I have an online consultation?
items.answer: Yes. Choose "Online" on the booking form and I will confirm the details with you on WhatsApp. Some problems need an in-person examination, and I will tell you if that is the case.

items.question: Where is the clinic?
items.answer: Zmedspa (MZ Derma Clinics), Klimmat Plaza, Asba and Dantata Street, Gwarinpa 2, Abuja.

items.question: How much does a consultation or treatment cost?
items.answer: Costs depend on the problem and the treatment. Message me on WhatsApp or ask at booking and I will give you a clear figure before you commit.

items.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
items.answer: Any creams, tablets or supplements you use, earlier test results, and a list of your questions. See the article on what to expect at your first visit.

items.question: Do laser and aesthetic treatments need more than one session?
items.answer: Often yes. The number of sessions depends on the treatment and your skin, and I explain this at your consultation.

items.question: Will my information be kept private?
items.answer: Yes. Your details are used only to arrange and carry out your care.
